An Atago Shrrine is a shrine of the {{ill|Atago Faith|ja|愛宕信仰}}
{{Nihongo|'''Atago Shrine'''|愛宕神社|Atago Jinja|qq=}} may refer to:
* [[Atago Shrine (Kyoto)]]
* [[Atago Shrine (Tokyo)]]
* Atago Shrine, once located on [[Atagoyama Kofun]], Gyōdo, Saitama Prefecture
* Atago Shrine, on [[Atagoyama Kofun (Mito)]], Ibaraki Prefecture

'''Atago Shrine''' (愛宕神社 or 愛宕社, Atago Jinja/Atago Sha) is the name for a number of Shinto shrines across Japan. See also  for more information.
== Head Shrine ==
* '''{{ill|Atago Shrine (Kyoto)|ja|愛宕神社 (京都市)}}''' (Kyoto City, Kyoto Prefecture)
